mathematical_contract.entry: the first and second subresultants must vanish identically before the cubic generic-common-fiber path is entered
mathematical_contract.cubic_reconstruction: the third subresultant is copied from a degree-three terminal equation or reconstructed by exact specialization and interpolation inside the configured degree budget
mathematical_contract.double_root_admission: the cubic discriminant must be the exact zero polynomial and b^2-3ac must be nonzero; the candidate is (9ad-bc)/(2(b^2-3ac))
mathematical_contract.triple_root_admission: when the discriminant and b^2-3ac are both the exact zero polynomial, the candidate is -b/(3a)
mathematical_contract.division_authority: the primitive D(r)l-N(r) factor must divide both authored bivariate equations exactly before publication
mathematical_contract.residual_authority: both exact quotients are retained and fed back through the same extractor until no supported factor remains
mathematical_contract.strict: STRICT uses exact subresultant zeroes, exact invariant identities, exact polynomial GCD reduction, exact division, and exact geometry replay
mathematical_contract.approximate_512: APPROXIMATE_512 uses the same component construction; only inherited Hyperreal equality terminals may stop at 512 bits and no approximate factor or parameter is synthesized
mathematical_contract.failure_semantics: a square-free distinct cubic, irreducible quadratic, unsupported coefficient tower, or failed exact division remains explicit incomplete evidence

direct_hypersolve_benchmark.method: five sequential optimized benchmark processes pinned to CPU 11; each 1000-iteration timing extracts all three exact residual factors
direct_hypersolve_benchmark.interpretation: the lane includes third-subresultant reconstruction and three exact two-equation cofactor divisions; the historical extractor returned NoLinearComponent, so no unresolved-versus-completed speed ratio is claimed

matched_release_benchmark.method: five interleaved all-feature release processes per revision pinned to CPU 11 with identical fixtures and iteration counts
matched_release_benchmark.interpretation: every pre-existing median remains within 1.58 percent; the completed repeated-cubic path is measured separately because it did not exist in the historical executable

static_callgraph.interpretation: this syntax graph is a navigation and source-complexity aid, not a reachability or binary-size proof
